name: Trifecta-Cab
author: emb417
description: 3-screen cab theme optimized for videos on all screens. Plus Attract Mode with Audio! The best popper replacement for VPinFE. (Cab variant: attract mode muted.)
change_log: Supports OS rotated portrait playfield and updated to use latest VPinFECore features. (Cab variant: attract mode muted, wheel card tuning, idle sleep.) Wheel: outgoing card now shrinks in step with the crossfade instead of ghosting at full size. Wheel: single sliding track — the two-track crossfade is gone, and with it the duplicate card and the density pulse. Launch: the playfield no longer flashes file_missing or the still PNG — the hero video is paused, not gutted.
